intent: REFACTOR application.yml: inspect the implementation for layering violations, blocking calls, unbounded buffers, hardcoded values and invariant gaps; improve clarity without changing the public surface or breaking tests. Spec: Externalized config file for the single deployable. Defines: spring.application.name; spring.r2dbc url/username/password from env vars (R2DBC_URL, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD) targeting the ledger schema; spring.flyway enabled with jdbc url/user/password from env and locations classpath:db/migration, schemas ledger; server graceful shutdown; and the pulsestream.telemetry.* tree bound by TelemetryProperties: reorder-window PT60S, reorder-buffer-capacity, window.size/slide, every channels.* capacity, and boundaries heart_rate 30-240, power 0-2500, cadence 0-220, swim_pace min 45 (no max). Sample window size/slide and capacities are tunable values documented as open questions in the domain slice. Property names must match TelemetryProperties exactly (relaxed kebab-case).
